resources.string: You run the butcher shop for one day. In the morning you cut up three carcasses (50 seconds at most) to fill the cold room; then you serve the customers (1 min 30). Your score adds up the points from cutting and serving, minus what is thrown away or botched. Three hygiene faults and the shop is closed down.

A carcass hangs from the rail and swings more and more. Move the knife with the left and right arrows and press A when the guide is green over a dotted line: dark green is perfect, green is good, red means the blade hits the bone and you lose points. Every clean cut gives a piece, stored in the cold room (twelve pieces at most). If you finish all three carcasses before time runs out, each second left earns points.

Each customer asks for a meat, one to three slices and a weight per slice. Pick the right piece in the cold room with the arrows and press A to take it (the wrong meat costs points and patience; a piece that is too small is refused). Then hold A: the meat moves toward the blade and the weight goes up; release A to cut inside the green zone of the right weight. Pieces age: their freshness bar goes from green to red, and a spoiled piece is thrown away (points lost). Selling a nearly spoiled piece earns a bonus: serve the oldest first.

Taking or cutting poultry dirties the work surface (green stain and flies). Before touching another meat, press B to clean it (it takes a moment): otherwise it is a hygiene fault. The health inspector also drops by without warning: a banner flashes for a few seconds, then he checks the surface. Clean: bonus; dirty: fine and a fault. On the third fault, the shop is closed down.

If your score reaches 500 points before the end of service (with enough time left), a sausage workshop opens between two customers, once only. Hold A to fill the casing, then press B to tie it off when the tail of the sausage is in the green zone. Overfill it and the casing bursts. Every good sausage earns points, with a streak bonus. The workshop lasts 18 seconds; service then resumes.

Solo game, in landscape. The left and right arrows are at the bottom left, the A and B buttons at the bottom right; a key can be held down. With a gamepad or in TV mode, the d-pad and the A and B buttons do the same; Start pauses, like the back button. Your best score is saved.
Press A to start. Cut the carcasses along the dotted lines, then serve the customers: right piece, right weight, clean surface.
Pieces cut: %1$d · Customers served: %2$d · Perfect slices: %3$d
Hold A to fill · B to tie off
